How it works

Point and we carry

You walk through with us, point at what goes, and set aside what stays. We do all the lifting, padding the railings and protecting the floors as we go.

Sorted before it leaves

Usable furniture and housewares are separated for donation. Metal, cardboard and appliances go to recyclers. Only what cannot be diverted goes to the transfer station.
